supports: deterministic Rule execution and replay integrity

dataset_limitations: The ten frozen records mix secondary reporting, duplicate/speculative pages, sparse retrospective material and truncated or scraped text; they are not independently reconciled history.
Draft relation and transaction endpoints conflict with actor-local names/actions in E2/E4/E5/E7/E8/E9/E10. The source rows remain frozen but do not confer runtime authority.

The 2016 proposed RMB45.6bn restructuring is conflated with the later near-30-percent Metro acquisition in Draft transactions. The simulation keeps proposal statements and later acquisition disclosures separate, without a financial ledger.

SRC010 reports a forthcoming June30 election, whereas the Draft header states that a new board was elected. The executable boundary is nomination, registration and meeting scheduling; the election result remains unobserved.

The unidentified December2015 LOI counterparty cannot be assigned to Metro from later knowledge. Mid-2016 Metro terms are introduced separately. Board rejection dates and overlapping episode ordering are unresolved.

P_2 aggregates issuer communication and a board-response record, with the board as decision owner; individual votes and internal corporate conflict require separate supported parents. Eight named Agents and no Population retain every Draft source participant.

Frozen-only Anbang, affiliates, analysts, unidentified investors, exchanges and election voters are not additional executable choice units. Exchange notices do not simulate exchange authorization, and proposals do not execute votes or securities transfers.
Full Draft exposure, authored activation windows, communication dependencies and logical-time compression preclude unbiased prediction, timing calibration or held-out claims.
